name: Fancy Footwork — "They each get" resolves to the one or two targets
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Untap one or two target creatures. They each get +2/+2 until end of turn.' produced no effect. _resolveTheyPronoun rewrites 'They' to 'one or two target creatures', and extractTargetInfo now reads 'N or M target …' (and 'any number of target …') as a multi-target subject instead of falling through to a global filter. Only the chosen creatures are boosted.
